title: 第166章 招贤令第165章 将计就计
slug: 绑定全国每人每天给我一两银
lines: 刺史府。
田世安看着自己安插的三人被抓，且人赃并获，面色极其难看。
“田刺史。”陆舟冷声开口：“你这云州官场的人还真是厉害啊！”
他语气咄咄逼人，将一沓账本供状甩到了他的面前：“监守自盗，真是轻车熟路！”
田世安也懵了。
他本想派这三人潜伏下来，好生打探消息。
没想到这才不到一个月，三人竟然就被利益蒙蔽被抓了。
最关键的是，这三人也是个软骨头，仅仅简单用刑就全招了，还说这是刺史大人安排他们来的。
“王爷，下官确实不知此事！”田世安还想辩驳。
但陆舟却懒得废话，沉声道：“本王敬你是一州刺史，给你留几分薄面。”
“可你倒好，派人潜入本王府邸，还贪墨王府财物。”
“怎么，是觉得本王这个王爷好欺负，还是觉得……”
他陡然拔高声音，气势全开：“你田世安，要与本王作对？”
最后一句话彻底吓到了田世安。
要是被扣上一顶“针对王爷”的帽子，那他就被动了。
他连忙否认：“王爷饶命，此事绝对是有人故意为之，就是为了栽赃嫁祸！”
“呵。”陆舟冷笑一声：“本王可不管这些，说吧，你准备怎么做！”
田世安自知理亏，神情尴尬：“下官全听王爷的吩咐！”
“好！”陆舟等的就是这句话，他开口道：“他们三人贪了多少，你要十倍赔回来。”
“十倍？”田世安失声。
这三人可是贪了一万多两，这十倍也太多了。
“怎么，田刺史有意见？”陆舟沉吟一声。
“没有……”田世安连连否认，急忙道：“下官赔！下官赔！”
陆舟继续道：“除此之外，这三人既然是你的官，那你怎么也得亲自给本王赔罪对不对？”
田世安疑惑。
紧接着他就听到对方道：“明日，你亲自来王府，当着所有人的面，给本王赔礼道歉！”
田世安脸色煞白。
亲自登门道歉？
当着王府所有人的面？
那他这个刺史的脸，就彻底丢尽了！
“王爷，可以私下道歉吗？我可以将赔款提高到二十倍。”田世安无奈道。
“不行。”陆舟斩钉截铁地说：“不然本王就上奏朝廷。”

Governor's Mansion.
田世安看着自己安插的三人被抓，且人赃并获，面色极其难看。
“田刺史。”陆舟冷声开口：“你这云州官场的人还真是厉害啊！”
His tone was aggressive, and he threw a stack of account books and confessions in front of him: "It's so easy to guard and steal!"
Tian Shian was also confused.
他本想派这三人潜伏下来，好生打探消息。
Unexpectedly, in less than a month, the three of them were blinded by their interests and arrested.
The most important thing is that these three people are also weaklings. They were all beaten by simple torture. They also said that the governor arranged for them to come.
"Your Majesty, I really don't know about this!" Tian Shi'an still wanted to argue.
But Lu Zhou was too lazy to talk nonsense, and said in a deep voice: "I respect you as the governor of a state, so I will give you some thin noodles."
“可你倒好，派人潜入本王府邸，还贪墨王府财物。”
"Why, do you think this prince is easy to bully, or do you think..."
He suddenly raised his voice and said with full momentum: "You, Tian Shi'an, want to go against this king?"
The last sentence completely frightened Tian Shian.
If he is labeled as "targeting the prince", then he will be passive.
He quickly denied: "My lord, please spare my life. This matter was definitely done deliberately by someone just to frame me up!"
"Ha." Lu Zhou sneered: "I don't care about this. Tell me what you are going to do!"
Tian Shi'an knew he was in the wrong and looked embarrassed: "All subordinates will obey the prince's orders!"
"Okay!" This was what Lu Zhou was waiting for. He said, "How much the three of them have embezzled, you have to pay back ten times."
"Ten times?" Tian Shian lost his voice.
These three people were greedy for more than ten thousand taels, and ten times was too much.
"Why, Governor Tian has any objections?" Lu Zhou groaned.
"No..." Tian Shi'an denied repeatedly and said hurriedly: "I'll apologize to you! I'll apologize to you!"
Lu Zhou continued: "Besides, since these three people are your officials, you have to personally apologize to me, right?"
Tian Shian was confused.
Then he heard the other party say: "Tomorrow, you come to the palace in person and apologize to me in front of everyone!"
Tian Shian's face turned pale.
Come to apologize in person?
In front of everyone in the palace?
Then his face as a governor would be completely disgraced!
"Your Majesty, can you apologize in private? I can increase the compensation to twenty times." Tian Shian said helplessly.
"No." Lu Zhou said firmly: "Otherwise, I will report to the court."
